body.message:
We do not accept this claim.

That table and the furniture have been in that unit for years. I know this because I work in real estate, and a colleague of mine sold that exact unit with the same furniture in August 2024.

Since then, multiple guests have stayed in the property. You have not provided any evidence that the table was not already damaged before we checked in, so there is no basis for holding us responsible.

We expect our full security deposit to be returned. This is not only because we did not cause the damage you are alleging, but also because of the numerous issues we experienced throughout our stay, including the property’s condition on arrival and your team’s ongoing lack of professionalism, communication, and accountability in resolving those issues.

Please process the return of our full deposit without any further unjustified deductions.
